films.title: The Twits
films.overview: When the meanest, nastiest villains pull a trick to take over their town, two brave children team up with a family of magical animals to bring them down.

films.title: Ralph Breaks the Internet
films.overview: Video game bad guy Ralph and fellow misfit Vanellope von Schweetz must risk it all by traveling to the World Wide Web in search of a replacement part to save Vanellope's video game, Sugar Rush. In way over their heads, Ralph and Vanellope rely on the citizens of the internet — the netizens — to help navigate their way, including an entrepreneur named Yesss, who is the head algorithm and the heart and soul of trend-making site BuzzzTube.
